_description: Salpa 1 USV — single source of truth for all physical and control parameters. All Python modules must read from here via salpa1_params.py.

added_mass._comment: Fraction of translational/rotational inertia — Xudot = xudot_frac * m, etc.

drag._comment: xu_lin_frac and xu_quad_frac split the drag between linear and quadratic terms.

control_defaults._comment_wn: Inner PID loop natural frequency [rad/s]. Kp = IZZ*wn², Kd = IZZ*2*zeta*wn - IZZ. Saturates at tau_yaw_max/Kp rad ≈ 64° at wn=1.5.
control_defaults._comment_zeta: Inner PID damping ratio [-]. 0.7 = Butterworth (no overshoot). Do not go below 0.5.
control_defaults._comment_wn_ref: Reference model (heading pre-filter) frequency [rad/s]. Must be < wn. Smooths the heading command ramp.
control_defaults._comment_zeta_ref: Reference model damping ratio [-]. 1.0 = critically damped (no overshoot on commanded heading).
control_defaults._comment_r_max: Max yaw-rate inside the reference model [deg/s]. 1000 = effectively unlimited. Set e.g. 20 to add hard rate limiting.
control_defaults._comment_delta: Speed-proportional look-ahead: Δ = max(delta_min_m, k_delta_s * U). k_delta_s is the CTE convergence time constant [s]: τ_ye = Δ/U = k_delta_s (constant at all speeds). Rule: k_delta_s >> settling_time = 4/(zeta*wn) ≈ 3.8 s. k=15 gives τ_ye=15s (4× margin).
control_defaults._comment_delta_min: Minimum look-ahead distance [m]. Safety floor used at very low speeds (< 0.5 m/s) to avoid numerical issues in ALOS. 5m = ~1 body length.
control_defaults._comment_threshold: Integrator anti-windup threshold [deg]. Integral only accumulates when |heading_error| < this value. Prevents wind-up during manoeuvres.
